title: PDF Link Map
user: Operations and technical-document teams converting HTML or DOCX to PDF who need to know whether navigation survives the conversion.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that accepts a PDF plus optional heading manifest, inventories internal/external annotations, validates destinations and duplicate anchors, and writes a clickable HTML map.
success_measure: Detect every deliberately broken TOC/list link in a fixture suite and make the command suitable for a release pipeline.
constraints: Never dereference external links by default
